purpose: Generic vocabulary exempt from the leak scan (gis check-literals, alias check-poi-literals): the POI values of #124 and the class (b) non-POI literals of #129 (docs/gis/rights/non-poi-literals.md). Each term is a common word or schema/file-name fragment that our own committed text, floor-label file names and non-POI sources use; none is a distinctive source value. Add a term only after confirming that, never to hide a leaked value. Every term added for #129 has its reason in `justifications`.

justifications.exception: Ordinary English word. It occurs inside our own evidence ids (plateau-related-provenance#ksj-exception-heading) in gaps and rights text; also a PLATEAU codelist description.
justifications.park: Ordinary English word. It occurs in our own source ids and layer names (plateau-13104-related-park-asset) and HANDOFF prose; also a PLATEAU codelist description.
justifications.river: Ordinary English word used in our own research prose (lane-d-review-fixes.md); also a PLATEAU codelist description.
justifications.road: Ordinary English word. It is our own feature-kind name in context reports and HANDOFF prose (road tran layer); also a PLATEAU codelist description.
justifications.unknown: Our own status marker (UNKNOWN stays unknown) written in lower case across reports; also a PLATEAU codelist description.
justifications.zone: Ordinary English word in our own CRS reports (JGD2011 plane rectangular zone IX, query parameter zone=9); also a PLATEAU codelist description.
justifications.地下2階: Generic floor word. fix-pass.md uses it as the name of a synthetic test case ('standalone B2, 地下2階, 階段室, 地下通路 cases'), not as a quote of a source floor label. Floor labels of the E27 station map are still hashed in the reports; this term only exempts that prose.
justifications.地下通路: Common noun for an underground passage. It is part of the class (a) PLATEAU group name kept in the inventory (gml:name 「池袋駅_B1地下通路」), appears in our own HANDOFF and fix-pass prose and test-case names, and is also MLIT route-structure label 5; the exact label is not policed because the same word legitimately appears in class (a) text.
